title: Breaker Bot 3000
description: A mod to automatically press stone buttons on observers.
body:
# Breaker Bot 3000

## this mod is considered a cheat on some servers, don't use unless you have permission

this mod will no longer be updated due to jonathan

This mod automatically presses breakers with a keybind (P by default)/command (/breakers)

Breakers are stone buttons on observers, this mod adds a keybind and a command to press all buttons on observers within 4 blocks.

has a delay between each button press so it has a wave effect for added satisfication
